entry.title: MS20XXL 0.2.0
entry.summary: MS20XXL for Force / MPC OS by L'Cronx. -mpc-armv7.zip: Force and the 32-bit MPCs. -mpc-aarch64.zip: the 64-bit MPCs (Live III, XL, One G2, Key G2). Install either: unzip, run install.sh (INSTALL.md inside), or use the MPC plugin installer. -mpc-sdk.zip: MPC OS 3.10.1 or later, any MPC: copy the folder into VST2 Plugins.
